title: Polynomial realization of a rational sequence with polynomial forward difference
statement: Let $f:\mathbf N\to\mathbf Q$ be a function, let $b\in\mathbf N$, and let $A\in\mathbf Q[X]$ be a polynomial [def-weil-polynomial-ring] of degree $\deg A<b$, with $\deg0=-\infty$. If $f(n+1)-f(n)=A(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbf N$, then there exists $R\in\mathbf Q[X]$ with $\deg R<b+1$ and $R(n)=f(n)$ for every $n\in\mathbf N$.
